question: An aeroplane travels distances 1320 km, 1760 km and 2095 km at the rate of 528 km/h, 352 km/h and 419 km/h, respectively. Find the average speed (in km/h) of the aeroplane.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 1320 + 1760 + 2095 = 5175 km.

Total Time = (1320 ÷ 528) + (1760 ÷ 352) + (2095 ÷ 419) = 2.5 + 5 + 5 = 12.5 hours.

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 5175 ÷ 12.5 = 414 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 414 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance D₁ = 1320 km, Speed S₁ = 528 km/h

Distance D₂ = 1760 km, Speed S₂ = 352 km/h

Distance D₃ = 2095 km, Speed S₃ = 419 km/h
